Yes

7. Comments (optional)
The Disputed Domains were registered by the Respondent when acting as the UK
distributor for the Complainant. That relationship has ended. The Respondent
accordingly has no further legitimate reason to retain the Disputed Domains, the use
of which is likely to cause the public to believe that the relationship continues in
being. The Disputed Domains are accordingly Abusive under paragraph 5.1.2 of the
DRS Policy.
8. Decision
2

I grant the Complainant’s application for a summary decision. In accordance
with section 12 of the Policy, the Disputed Domains will therefore be
transferred to the Complainant.
